about.title: Head Tennis Coach
about.bio: With years of experience coaching players from beginner through competitive tournament level, I focus on the technical precision and match intelligence that turn practice into results. My players learn to hit harder, move smarter, and compete with composure under pressure.

hero.headline: Serve. Rally. Win.
hero.subline: Private tennis coaching — stroke mechanics, match strategy, and tournament prep for players who want to win more matches.

services.title: Stroke Mechanics
services.description: Forehand, backhand, serve, and volley — individual sessions targeting your specific weaknesses and building a complete technical game.

services.title: Match Strategy & Mental Game
services.description: Pattern play, court positioning, shot selection, and the mental discipline to execute your game plan when it matters most.

services.title: Tournament Prep
services.description: Structured pre-tournament sessions targeting opponent analysis, serve-return patterns, and competition-day focus.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: I work with players from 6 years old through adult competitive level. Lessons are designed for your current skill set — beginners welcome.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place at local tennis facilities and courts. Specific location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: Standard sessions are 60 minutes. Extended sessions (90 min) are available for players working on multiple areas.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: Tennis shoes (non-marking), a racquet, and water. Balls are provided.

faq.question: Do you offer group sessions?
faq.answer: Yes — small group lessons (2–3 players) are available for players at similar skill levels. Contact me for availability and pricing.
